The '''Alfestril system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nevik]] suspected that [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] undercover agents were working in the Alfestril system. His crew aboard the [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] had discovered this information in a coded transmission between [[Central Commander]] [[Sollaine]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Although Nevik attempted to investigate, Commander Sollaine executed the captain when he refused an order to travel to [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]].<ref name="SF">{{JournalCite|12|Small Favors}}</ref>
